frontend.selection: GeneralOde and AutomaticOde select only DOPRI5/RODAS5P; switching occurs at committed boundaries.
limitations: Public Problem is f64 slice based with Dense/Banded/FiniteDifference/JVP derivative providers.
Output, events, mass matrix and JVP capabilities differ by route and require capability checks.
Two-step peer history/startup is not represented by the current public facade.
The current facade is not a portfolio of all internal algorithms.

taxonomy_rules: A step kernel, operator, matrix-function action, selector, verified model or example is not automatically a general-purpose solver.
Method identity includes equations/tableau, coefficient source, controller, estimator, startup, history, restart and dense-output formula.
Time-stage parallelism means independent current-step method stages. RHS rows, JVP rows, spatial cells and IVP ensembles are separate axes.
JVP is a derivative action, not derivative-free.
Matrix-free means no explicit matrix materialization; it does not mean no derivative action, preconditioner or linear solve.
Newton-free does not mean solve-free, derivative-free or globally convergent.
No order/stability property is inherited when changing method family.
